description: Use this to correct or remove one recipient in a list from import_address_list, by row number. Given fields replace the stored values and omitted fields keep theirs; if the row's problem says it could not be read, pass name, line1, city, state and zip together. Re-runs the required-field and US address format checks, plus USPS verification when it is configured. Format checks alone do not confirm that an address is deliverable. remove: true takes the recipient out of the mailing. Rows in a list that belongs to a paid order cannot be changed.

remove.description: Remove this recipient from the mailing.

name: fix_address
title: Fix or remove a recipient
